blocks.title: Identify the operation
blocks.text: The print job that arrived first must leave first.

blocks.title: Match the structure
blocks.text: Enqueue adds jobs; dequeue removes the oldest one. This is a queue.

blocks.title: Justify and qualify
blocks.text: A stack gives LIFO, which is the wrong order. Other systems may also need priority queues if priority overrides arrival order.
